prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [val2] 中英混排 · 二维合并发布矩阵 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "Platform" spans 1 col × 2 row; "v3.2" spans 2 col × 1 row; "v3.3" spans 2 col × 1 row; "与 Android 同步发布，等待 App St" spans 2 col × 2 row; "持续部署，无版本概念" spans 2 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "Platform" · longest unbreakable word 62px · one-line width 62px
  col 2: header "v3.2 › Beta" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 44px
  col 3: header "v3.2 › GA" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 4: header "v3.3 › Beta" · longest unbreakable word 33px · one-line width 33px
  col 5: header "v3.3 › GA" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 333px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 332px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各平台在 v3.2 和 v3.3 阶段的发布日期或发布状态。","reading":"读者先按平台定位行，再横向比较各版本的 Beta 和 GA；iOS 与 Android 共用的 v3.3 说明也需要跨行阅读。","groups":["第 2、3 列同属 v3.2，分别表示 Beta 和 GA。","第 4、5 列同属 v3.3，分别表示 Beta 和 GA；跨列、跨行的发布说明关联 iOS 和 Android。","第 1 列是平台名称，应与右侧版本数据明确区分。"],"keep_intact":["平台名称和表头 Platform","日期、版本号以及 Beta、GA 标识","Android、App Store 等英文名称"],"may_wrap":["较长的中文发布说明可在自然语义处换行，英文名称应保持完整。","Web 行的持续部署说明可利用跨两列的宽度换行；iOS 与 Android 共用的说明可利用两行合并单元格的高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [83, 65, 65, 54, 65] · table 333×286px · row heights [36, 36, 76, 76, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"平台名称、日期、版本号和英文名称均保持完整；两级表头清楚地区分了版本及 Beta、GA。iOS 与 Android 共用的 v3.3 说明跨行呈现，Web 行也能作为一个整体阅读。","problems":"v3.3 的共用说明较拥挤，中文在“同步”和“通过后”等语义处被拆开，六行文字使 iOS 和 Android 两行明显偏高。Web 的持续部署说明也换成两行。","cause":"第 4、5 列合计 119px，扣除合并单元格的内边距后，长说明的可用行宽有限；第 2、3 列合计 130px，Web 说明也不足以一行放下。可重新分配的宽度很少：第 1 列的 83px 已对应 Platform 的完整宽度，第 2、3、5 列的 65px 已对应其最长单行内容，第 4 列的 54px 则对应 Beta 的完整宽度。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
